sql.contentHashes:
SELECT * FROM (SELECT owner.id AS node_id,
  substr(json_extract(resource.value, '$.storage_key'), 1, 64) AS attachment_id, substr(json_extract(resource.value, '$.storage_key'), 1, 64) AS content_hash,
  json_extract(resource.value, '$.storage_key') AS storage_key, json_extract(resource.value, '$.role') AS role,
  json_extract(resource.value, '$.original_name') AS original_name,
  CASE substr(json_extract(resource.value, '$.storage_key'), 65) WHEN '.epub' THEN 'application/epub+zip' WHEN '.pdf' THEN 'application/pdf' WHEN '.pdftext' THEN 'application/vnd.foliole.pdf-text+json' WHEN '.gif' THEN 'image/gif' WHEN '.jpg' THEN 'image/jpeg' WHEN '.png' THEN 'image/png' WHEN '.webp' THEN 'image/webp' END AS mime_type,
  'unresolved' AS availability, 0 AS size_bytes
  FROM nodes owner, json_each(owner.resource_references) resource) resource WHERE attachment_id IN (__ATTACHMENT_ID_FILTER__)

topicSearch.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE visible_nodes(id) AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM nodes
  WHERE parent_id IS NULL
    AND deleted_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT child.id
  FROM nodes child INDEXED BY idx_nodes_parent_id
  INNER JOIN visible_nodes parent
    ON parent.id = child.parent_id
  WHERE child.deleted_at IS NULL
) SELECT n.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(n.title), ''), 'Untitled') AS title, n.opening_text, CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(n.content, '')) = '' THEN 'empty' ELSE 'ready' END AS content_status, n.updated_at, max(0, instr(lower(n.content), ?) - 1) AS match_start, trim(substr(n.content, max(1, instr(lower(n.content), ?) - 80), 160)) AS excerpt FROM nodes n INNER JOIN visible_nodes visible ON visible.id = n.id WHERE (instr(lower(COALESCE(n.title, '')), ?) > 0 OR instr(lower(COALESCE(n.opening_text, '')), ?) > 0 OR instr(lower(n.content), ?) > 0) ORDER BY n.updated_at DESC, n.created_at DESC, n.id ASC LIMIT ?
